description: Taxonomy of 8 custom object classes and 3 geometric surface classes for urban footpath encroachment detection and accessibility assessment.
academic_reference: EncroWatch AI Revised Research Paper, Sections 3.1 & 6.3

custom_object_classes.name: motorcycle
custom_object_classes.description: Motorcycles, scooters, mopeds, and two-wheelers parked or moving on the designated pedestrian footpath or curb zone.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Any two-wheeled motorized or electric transport vehicle whose wheels or body rest on or overhang the pedestrian walkway.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Two-wheelers situated fully within the active roadway carriageway with zero pedestrian corridor overlap.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Lower 40% bounding box height or tire-pavement contact polygon.

custom_object_classes.name: car
custom_object_classes.description: Hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, auto-rickshaws, and light commercial vehicles parked or standing on or across pedestrian footpaths.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Four-wheel passenger or commercial vehicles encroaching onto the paved sidewalk, pedestrian plaza, or curb transition.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Vehicles moving legally on designated vehicular lanes or parked in authorized on-street marked bays without sidewalk overhang.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Tire ground-contact patch (lower 30-40% bounding box) to prevent overestimating upper chassis overhang.

custom_object_classes.name: vendor_cart
custom_object_classes.description: Mobile four-wheeled pushcarts, handcarts, fruit/vegetable stands, tea stalls, and fast-food trolleys occupying the pedestrian corridor.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Wheeled or semi-fixed vendor units occupying pedestrian right-of-way, reducing effective walkway width.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Indoor store displays, or carts located strictly off-street on private property behind the property setback line.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Wheel-and-stand ground footprint polygon; canopy tarps annotated separately under umbrella_canopy.

custom_object_classes.name: construction_debris
custom_object_classes.description: Piles of sand, gravel, construction aggregate, brick stacks, excavated earth, and demolition rubble dumped onto footpaths.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Loose materials or accumulated solid construction debris that physically restrict pedestrian clearance or cause trip hazards.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Pre-installed municipal pavement pavers, drainage grates, or permanent civil structures.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Full base polygon intersecting the pavement.

custom_object_classes.name: commercial_signboard
custom_object_classes.description: Portable A-frame chalkboard signs, promotional flex standees, banner tripods, and retail advertising displays placed on sidewalks.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Temporary or semi-permanent commercial advertising boards standing in the clear walking zone.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Permanent overhead municipal street name signs or traffic regulatory boards mounted on sanctioned posts > 2.20m high.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Base feet / tripod contact polygon (lower 20% bounding box).

custom_object_classes.name: shop_extension
custom_object_classes.description: Retail store spillover, clothing racks, shoe racks, plastic milk/beverage crates, and merchandise display tables extending beyond building lines.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Store inventory or merchandise racks placed on public sidewalks outside formal shop shutters.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Architectural features of the building located entirely behind the legal municipal property boundary.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Base support footprint on the walkway.

custom_object_classes.name: umbrella_canopy
custom_object_classes.description: Large vendor sun umbrellas, polythene tarpaulins, cloth awnings, and temporary overhead shades.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: Overhanging fabric/plastic shades associated with vendor stalls or street kiosks.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Permanent sanctioned building porticos, bus shelter roofs, or pedestrian umbrellas carried by moving pedestrians.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Subject to dual-projection vertical gating: ground support pole vs. elevated canopy polygon with 2.20m headroom clearance check.

custom_object_classes.name: pedestrian
custom_object_classes.description: Walking, standing, or sitting human pedestrians, including wheelchair users and caregivers pushing strollers.
custom_object_classes.inclusion_criteria: All human subjects located in the urban scene.
custom_object_classes.exclusion_criteria: Statues, mannequins, or printed figures on commercial billboards.
custom_object_classes.contact_proxy_rule: Feet contact patch (lower 15-20% bounding box). Not classified as an obstruction.

geometric_surface_classes.name: footpath_polygon
geometric_surface_classes.description: Continuous polygonal region representing the paved or designated pedestrian walkway corridor.

geometric_surface_classes.name: roadway_polygon
geometric_surface_classes.description: Continuous polygonal region representing the vehicular carriageway surface.

geometric_surface_classes.name: curb_line
geometric_surface_classes.description: Linear or ribbon boundary separating the pedestrian sidewalk from the roadway carriageway.

geometric_surface_classes.name: ground_contact_mask
geometric_surface_classes.description: Precise binary mask of physical contact between an encroaching object and the ground pavement surface.
